label: أرقام

gfx.label: الأرباح التشغيلية في 6 أشهر
gfx.note: من أبريل إلى سبتمبر 2026، حسب كونامي

note: Primary: Konami Group consolidated results, six months to 30 Sep 2026 (IR, 29 Oct 15:30 JST, en1029_ych6cy.pdf): revenue 307,975m yen (+37.0%), operating profit 111,264m yen (+73.1%), record first half; drivers per Konami: eFootball (campaigns, major update), METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.2 and SILENT HILL: Townfall launches, Yu-Gi-Oh! card products; full-year operating profit forecast raised from 143,000m to 193,000m yen (en1029_hmbg26.pdf). The digest's '+75.1% to 107.5B' is the Digital Entertainment segment business profit, not used. Footage: Steam MGS Master Collection Vol.2 trailer (Big Boss salute, Snake), Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel trailer (cards, Cyber End Dragon); no eFootball file reachable. Sound: Master Duel trailer music from 10 s (no speech 8 to 78 s); the MGS trailer is narrated throughout.
